lead.en: Phaya Thai is the city's airport hinge: the ARL City Line terminates here against the BTS Sukhumvit Line (platforms ~121 m apart, skywalk since 2010), one stop from Siam and ~half an hour from Suvarnabhumi. The unit's identity is transport first - the station paradoxically sits in Ratchathewi district - with a practical street life of hospital and office traffic, plentiful food, Suan Pakkad Palace Museum ~350-400 m east inside the unit, and the 1909 Phaya Thai Palace ~1.3 km north, outside the catchment. Rents (25,000/43,500) match the catchment's 1-BR/2-BR medians well. What the score cannot show: no verifiable safety data behind the 5, an unidentified 1.1 ha park polygon, and a railway corridor being progressively cleared for the three-airport high-speed line.

strengths.en: The only BTS-ARL interchange in the city core: one-stop Siam access plus a direct airport line, with 800 m catchment rents matching the app's stated figures.
A real heritage-green anchor inside the unit: Suan Pakkad Palace Museum (~350-400 m) with its five traditional houses and 450-year-old Lacquer Pavilion.

tradeoffs.en: Safety 5 has no evidence base either way in this pass - it stays an unanchored dataset value rather than a documented condition.
The green story is thinner than the 8 suggests: no named public park inside the catchment was found, and the 1.1 ha polygon is unmatched (Suan Pakkad's grounds are a ticketed museum).

dayNight.en: The interchange dominates mornings and evenings with commuter and airport flows; midday belongs to hospital/office errands and food stalls; evenings and weekends are low-key.

variation.en: The station-and-skywalk block is the loudest node; the Si Ayutthaya/Suan Pakkad side east is calmer, and the SRT/rail-corridor edge west carries the clearance works.

fit.en: Strong fit: frequent flyers and BTS commuters priced out of Siam/Ratchathewi proper - the rent medians here are the interchange's own.
Poor fit: households wanting leafy park-side living or destination nightlife; neither exists in this catchment.

uncertainties: rating safety (5): no unit-level statistics found; unanchored in this pass (phaya-thai-st-c07).
Park identity: the app's 1.1 ha polygon did not match any named OSM park within 900 m of the stations (phaya-thai-st-c09).
Anchor sits ~340 m north of the BTS node; edge memberships toward Victory Monument need polygon re-check (phaya-thai-st-c02).
ARL headway (~10 min peak) is snippet-level only; the Wikipedia body documents fares and the 2014 express suspension but not current headways (phaya-thai-st-c03).
Railway-corridor displacement affects the corridor generally; overlap with this specific Voronoi cell is undetermined (phaya-thai-st-c11).
